Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly execute the instruction to open the URL `https://www.brooklyn.cuny.edu/`. Instead of navigating to the official CUNY domain, it repeatedly loaded the page `https://www.brooklyn.edu/`. This is a critical error because the task explicitly required finding official statements confirming the college's parent organization from the CUNY domain, which is where such information is hosted. By loading the wrong URL, the agent could not access the necessary authoritative source to confirm that Brooklyn College is part of the City University of New York, despite the Planner repeatedly instructing it to do so.
